slots.name: executive count
slots.sentence: Earlier this year, Nadella named Roslansky and two other executives as leaders of the Microsoft 365 applications and the Copilot artificial intelligence platform, and Dan Shapero, LinkedIn's chief operating officer, became the professional social network's CEO.
